info.description: The RESTS APIs for using CCAI Webhooks
info.title: CloudContactAI Webhooks API Documentation

get.description: This endpoint allows you to get all the subscriptions for your client

200.description: Successful request, will return a list of all subscriptions

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a Subscription for your client.

200.description: Successful request, will create a Subscription and return the object back to you.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to get a Subscription by its ID.

200.description: Successful request, will get a Subscription.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update a Subscription by its ID.

200.description: Successful request, will update the Subscription and return the object.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a Subscription by its ID.

200.description: Successful request, will delete the Subscription.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.
